decisions.title: How should API keys work for programmatic access?

Custom API key table in DynamoDB with a dedicated /api/keys endpoint

decisions.answer: Custom API key table in DynamoDB with a dedicated /api/keys endpoint

decisions.title: How should the frontend handle login?

Custom login form in index.html calling Cognito SDK directly

decisions.title: How to handle existing links that have no OwnerId?

Leave them ownerless and visible to admin only

decisions.answer: Assign all existing links to Darko's user ID during migration

decisions.title: Which domain should host the Cognito login page?

Cognito default domain (krtk-rs.auth.<region>.amazoncognito.com)
decisions.recommended: Custom domain auth.krtk.rs (needs an extra ACM cert in us-east-1)
decisions.answer: Custom domain auth.krtk.rs (needs an extra ACM cert in us-east-1)

options: No — persistence only, never on the wire
Yes — include it so API clients can confirm ownership

decisions.answer: No — persistence only, never on the wire

Add a new OwnerIndex GSI on OwnerId, keep SortKey as LINKS

decisions.title: Where should API key records live?

Single-table design in linkTable using a LinkId prefix

decisions.answer: A separate apiKeyTable with KeyHash as PK

decisions.title: How should the two credential types be verified?

No gateway authorizer; verify inside each handler
decisions.recommended: Custom Lambda authorizer on /api/links + native pool authorizer on /api/keys
decisions.answer: Custom Lambda authorizer on /api/links + native pool authorizer on /api/keys
